hero.title: Restoring Hope & Dignity
hero.quote: "Serving humanity with Ihsan, ethical stewardship, and radical transparency."

story.title: From a Humble Beginning to a Nationwide Lifeline
story.paragraph1: Aasra Welfare Society was founded in 2021 in Lahore, Pakistan, with a deeply personal conviction: no orphan should ever feel abandoned, unloved, or uneducated.
story.paragraph2: What started with a handful of children in a modest home has grown into an impactful welfare society. We combine long-term orphan sponsorship with urgent emergency water wells and disaster relief, operating with 100% direct accountability.

1.title: The Foundation in Lahore
1.text: Established in Lahore with a heartfelt mission: to rescue orphaned children from destitution, providing full shelter, family care, and formal schooling.

2.title: Clean Water Expansion
2.text: Launched our dedicated hand pump installation initiative across underserved Punjab villages, surpassing 170+ clean water projects with individual donor dedication plaques.

3.title: Emergency Flood Relief & Rapid Response
3.text: Mobilized emergency field response teams during catastrophic floods across South Punjab and Sindh, delivering waterproof tents, food rations, clean water, and rehabilitation.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: A compassionate, equitable society where orphans thrive, clean drinking water is accessible to every rural home, and no family sleeps hungry.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: Delivering holistic welfare services through character-building education, permanent clean water infrastructure, and transparent emergency distribution.

commitmentBox.title: 100% Policy Guarantee
commitmentBox.text: AASRA Welfare Society does not subtract administrative overhead from your designated charity gifts. Every rupee reaches the children and field projects directly.

registrations.title: Officially Registered & Verified NGO
registrations.subtitle: Fully compliant with Pakistani non-profit statutes, social welfare regulations, and charity commission audits.
